notes.title: Content News & Bug Fixes (v.1.3.7)
notes.notes:
Hey all, just another small bug fix patch while I work on the upcoming content. I have the new hero and about 20 of the 30+ new items finished. 

Just a reminder for those who haven't been following - all of your hero levels will soon pool together to slowly unlock new items and a new hero. This update is looking like it will launch somewhere around 13th March.

In case you wanted to prepare, you will need an average of lv5 on each hero to have all of the new content unlocked instantly (100 total levels), but only 25 total levels for the new hero.

With this new slowly changing meta new players will experience, it makes sense for the feature of different save slots to become a big priority. I want players who will unlock all the new content instantly to be able to experience it in its slower form as well if they choose. The update won't have the save slots feature, but it will be added not long after.

After this next big update, what I'll be looking at adding in future is requested features, and some additional end game content. What form this end game content will take I can't share quite yet. 

As a little teaser for what I can share, here's a sneak preview of the new hero, The Fallen:

notes.title: Merchant Update (v.1.3.4)
notes.notes:
Patch 1.3.4
Hey all, the big item (and new hero) update is coming along nicely, but I figured I may as well push these changes through now for you all to play around with.
~ Dale


General Changes

 For the cost of 15 gold, you can now restock/reroll a merchant. Using this feature saves the game.
 The merchant now carries a 2nd ancient item instead of a 3rd potion.
 The average cost of items at the merchant has been reduced slightly.
 Updates to the backpack and merchant exit button sprites.


Item Changes

Items with 'start of combat' effects will now always activate in the most beneficial order possible. Previously the order of activation was somewhat inconsistent, making most effects not interact. I'll also mention the previous start of combat resolution order of "Item > Hero > Enemy" has not been altered, this change only affects interactions between items. Here are some examples of the new interactions:

 Plate of the Fallen/Veil of the Holy Mother + Warlord's Burden/Life-giving Chamber - The damage is avoided and you gain the effects. The description on Life-giving Chamber has been updated to reflect that the buff is not based on the damage actually inflicted. This interaction was already in the game, but required the items to be equipped in a certain order, which is no longer required. Having one of these items activate the Juggernaut's passive ability will also add to the effect of the items mentioned below.
 Salem's Shadow Boots/Seeker of Virtue/Shard of the Deep/Hag's Hex Bag + Fenrir's Bane - The damage from Fenrir's Bane is now placed after these effects are calculated. The initial shield from War Mage's Greatstaff will also now benefit from start of combat ATK increases. 
 Tower Shield/Seeker of Virtue + Final Bastion - The initial shield from Final Bastion will now benefit from these effects.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a visual bug where the Ronin wouldn't apply a mark to summoned enemies.
 Fixed Ragnarok (ancient item) not hitting all enemies (and added a different animation).
 Fixed a bug where Ascension Cloak wouldn't work when the enemy is already attacking their 2nd preferred target.


Official Discord: https://discord.gg/5cBSPKk

notes.title: Frost & Item Changes (v.1.3.3)
notes.notes:
Patch 1.3.3
A substantial change this patch is changing the max Frost stacks from 5 to 10. This is to allow effects based on Frost to scale more gradually over combat. Several Frost items and abilities have been adjusted due to this change. 

The debuff at max stacks is staying the same, Frost is not now twice as effective. While setting the max stacks at 5 made sense in the initial iterations of the game, it became too easy a cap to hit later on. Having a higher number of stacks also makes it a much easier effect to design items around.

With this change, the Frostmancer won't have such an easy time obliterating groups of enemies. There are no changes to how the Frostmancer works overall, it will just require a little more investment to pull off. A mechanic with the Frostmancer I'll point out which isn't too clear - their active ability applies Frost from their passive BEFORE calculating damage and stun duration. This means a fully upgraded Frostmancer can still reap havoc with no support whatsoever, splashing Frost between enemies for many additional Frost stacks.

General Changes:

 Frost can now stack 10 times, and has had its effect per stack halved.
 The end of game victory window has been shifted so the heroes aren't covered.
 The Puzzling Box Act 3 event has had its Morale cost reduced, and has a 3x higher chance of giving the item exclusive to the event.
 Added a particle effect when MP is stolen (Witch Stick).

Frost Related Changes:

 Frostmancer passive ability - Applying Frost is now guaranteed.
 Frostmancer active ability - Additional damage per Frost has been reduced 40% and Stun per stack has been reduced 50%.
 Bottled Blizzard (potion) - Now applies 5 Frost instead of 3 (10 with the stronger potions blessing).
 Fenrir's Bane (common) - Now applies 2/3/4 Frost instead of 1/2/3.
 Sleetstone Sabre (common) - Your Attacks have a 30%/60%/90% chance to apply Frost to your target > Your Attacks have a 50% chance to both apply Frost and deal 3/6/9 Piercing damage for each stack of Frost on your target.
 Tundra Talisman (rare) - Apply 1/2/3 Frost to a random enemy every 2 seconds > Apply 1/2/3 Frost to all enemies every 3 seconds.
 Frozen Shell (rare) - 10/20/30 DEF > 15/30/45 DEF.
 Frozen Shell (rare) - Increase your Defense by 3/6/9 for every active stack of Frost > Increase your Defense by 1/2/3 for every active stack of Frost.
 Avalanche (ancient) - Your Attacks remove a stack of Frost from your target. If successful, you deal 50%/100%/150% Attack Damage to your target and any adjacent enemies > When you Attack, if your target has 10 Frost, remove all Frost and deal 350%/700%/1050% Attack Damage to your target and any adjacent enemies.

Item Changes:

 Bandit Hood (rare) - Your Attacks have a 4%/8%/12% chance to find 1 Gold > Your Attacks have a 5%/10%/15% chance to find 1 Gold.
 Bandit Hood (rare) - Now has a sound effect when it activates.
 Forgotten Idol (rare) - Now always hits your target. Now has a passive 10/20/30 Starting MP.
 Book of the First (rare) - Every 5/4/3 times you Attack, gain 1 Negate > Every 5/4/3 times you Attack, you and a random adjacent ally gain Negate.
 Book of the First (rare) - No longer gives a passive SPD bonus.
 Seed Relic (event) - Now applies Poison at the start of combat and every 5 seconds, instead of every 3 seconds.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the Bard and Spore Spewer not triggering enemy effects when attacking.
 Fixed a gold exploit from reward windows.
 Fixed Helm of the Mad King not adding its new values from a past patch.
 Fixed a rare bug where the Hydra would be defeated before every head was gone.

notes.title: Music Update + My Thanks (v.1.1.4)
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I've seen a massive surge of new players come through over the past few days. I just wanted to thank everyone sincerely for your support. With the recent success, I can confirm there will be a sequel (although story wise, a prequel).

Not too soon though, because I'm currently working on a big free update coming out near the end of February including a new mode, a new hero, new items, and events. The game has now also sold enough copies to be able to add Steam trading cards, so those will be coming soon.

Patch 1.1.4
Some music in the game has been replaced to be more copyright friendly to content creators. The new tracks are:

 The main theme
 The victory theme
 The ruins theme
 The alley theme

If any content creator's have a copyright claim, please contact me at dev.dturner@gmail.com with the url of the video so I can get the claim removed.

There is also now a unique victory theme when beating the final boss. I've heard the feedback that the base music volume for the game is a little low, so I'll be increasing that in a future patch.

~ Dale

notes.title: Rewards Update! (v.1.1.0)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Let me first thank everyone who has purchased the game, shared it with friends, submitted a review, or posted feedback. It is greatly appreciated.

The main purpose of this patch is to address the feedback that items can begin to stockpile towards the end of a run and feel cumbersome. As a solution, in reward windows you can now take an extra gold reward instead of an item. 

The gold reward is equal to the sell value of the highest grade item in the reward options, so there is now no reason to take an item purely to sell at a merchant later. This also gives you quicker access to your overall wealth for use in events.

Patch 1.1.0
General Changes:

 The Act 1 backgrounds have had visual updates.
 Helper tooltips will now position below the main one when possible.


Enemy Changes:

 The final boss' active ability will now only remove 2 random positive effects from each hero instead of all of them.


~ Dale

notes.title: Full Release Patch! (v.1.0.0)
notes.notes:
My Astronarch,

We have officially entered full release! The final 10 Corruption Levels have now been added, making 20 total. The heroes' aura will grow ever stronger as these new challenges are overcome, culminating in a true test of will. Completing Corruption 20 will reward you with a mini-epilogue, completing the story.

You can also now earn cosmetic upgrades for the tavern. A new "Challenges" button is available in the tavern, which shows the achievements you must complete and where the reward will get placed.

Patch 1.0.0
General Changes:

 Corruption 11-20 can now be unlocked.
 Cosmetic upgrades can now be earned in the tavern.
 The Ranger's companions are now viewable in the tavern.
 Ancient items you find will now always be different to ones you already have.
 The Fiend's resurrect, Warlock's passive, Ronin's active, and Brawler's active abilities now have a visual indicator to show their progress.


Hero Changes:

 Warlock's passive ability - Heal 1%/2%/3% and gain 5/10/15 ATK and DEF for each knocked out hero > Heal 2%/4%/6% and gain 10/20/30 ATK and DEF for each knocked out hero.
 Pyromancer's active ability - Now deals 50% less base damage, but all of it's damage is now piercing.
 Fiend's active ability - Apply a bleed equal to 6%/12%/16% of your Max HP > 10%/20%/30%.
 Ranger's companion Shiva - 300 Max HP > 500 Max HP.


Enemy Changes:

 Carrion Spawn's active ability - 100% Piercing Attack Damage > 50% Piercing Attack Damage.
 Manticore's active ability - No longer applies Ruin.


Item Changes:

 High Elf Claymore - Your Attacks have a 15%/30%/45% chance to deal an additional 40% damage to your target > Your Attacks have a 20%/40%/60% chance to deal an additional 50% damage to your target.
 Haldonir's Cursed Blade - Heal for 20%/40%/60% of your damage > 50%/100%/150%.
 Esoteric Keystone - Gain 10%/20%/30% of the MP expended by enemies > 25%/50%/75%.
 Yuki's Hurricane - At the start of combat, increase your SPD by 30%/60%/90% for 6 seconds > 40%/60%/80% for 6/7/8 seconds.
 Helm of the Mad King - Attackers increase your ATK by 2 and SPD by 2% >  Attackers increase your ATK by 3 and SPD by 3%.
 Helm of the Mad King - Now has the Protected keyword.


A special thanks to everyone who gave feedback during Early Access, you all played a part in making a game I am very proud of. I wish you all well in your future adventures.

~ Dale

notes.title: Resolution Update - Early Access v.3.4.0
notes.notes:
Hey all,

The main feature of this update is the new "Fit to Screen" option, which enables the game to now be displayed much larger for those below and above a 1920px wide screen.

General Changes:

 New "Fit to Screen" option will stretch the game window to your monitor.
 Tooltips are now vertically centred on the mouse.
 Text is now displayed more crisp in places where it was blurry.
 A tooltip will now appear for heroes who haven't been unlocked showing how they are unlocked.
 Heroes who have their position altered during combat now move back to their original positions.
 Event items will now display a tooltip in the item library showing the item location.
 Heroes in the tavern will now have their level display dimmed if they cannot gain xp from the current corruption level.


Hero Changes:

 The Wildmage's passive ability now activates every time their shield is depleted, but deals half the previous damage. This provides brand new synergies with sources of shield.


This will be the last major update before full release later this month. If anyone has any issues with the new "Fit to Screen" feature, please don't hesitate to let me know on the discussion board, thanks.

~ Dale

notes.title: New Items, Events, and Fixes - Act 3 Pre-Patch (Early Access v.2.0.5)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I had to push through a bug fix and figured why not add in some new items and changes early. Let's consider this the Act 3 pre-patch! Act 3 itself is still a while off, likely to be ready around the end of August.

There are two new status effects being added which mainly appear in Act 3, but it is possible to encounter them earlier.

New Stuff

 New negative status: Leech. This effect heals enemies when they damage you.
 New negative status: Revenge. This effect deals damage to you based on your damage dealt.
 7 new items have been added.
 A new potion has been added.
 A new Oracle blessing has been added in Act 2 which increases Shield generated.
 A new Oracle blessing has been added in Act 2 which increases upgrade chance in rewards.
 Your playtime is now displayed after a run.


Changes

 A Major Curse can now also apply Leech or Revenge, and can no longer apply Doom.
 Disarm and Silence now drain the related attack bar for 3 seconds instead of skipping an attack.
 Shields now begin to drain after a short delay.
 Removed immunity to damage over time effects from enemies, and other minor adjustments.
 Fixed a bug where the game would try to scale outside the 16:9 aspect ratio.


~ Dale

notes.title: Minor Class & Art Changes (Early Access v.2.0.4)
notes.notes:
Hi all, this is the last planned patch before Act 3. I'll see you all next month when I come out of the hyperbolic dev chamber ~ Dale.

Changes

The Frostmancer now applies Frost 20% more often. Upgrades now give additional chances to apply Frost as well as applying to adjacent enemies.
The Ronin's Bleed effect is now 200% Attack Damage, down from 300%.
The oracle blessing "The Hermit" now deals 10 damage to attackers, up from 5.
The elites and bosses in Act 1 have been redrawn at twice their resolution to match all other enemies in the game.
The alley background has been adjusted to be less busy looking.
Crashes will now save the crash log to your clipboard.

notes.title: Bloodmage Buffs, Item Changes, & Bug Fixes (Early Access v.2.0.3)
notes.notes:
Changes

The Bloodmage now spends 5% current HP every 2 seconds, instead of 4% Max HP.
The healing portion of the Bloodmage's Passive Ability is now 2x/3x/4x HP spent, up from 1x/1.5x/2x.
The damage portion of the Bloodmage's Passive Ability is now 1x/2x/3x HP spent, up from 1x/1.5x/2x.
The base damage of the Bloodmage's Active Ability is now 100%/200%/300% Attack Damage, up from 100%/100%/100%.
The Magician blessing now reduces Ability costs by 15%, up from 10%.
The ancient item Yuki's Hurricane now gives 30%/60%/90% Speed, up from 25%/50%/75%.
The ancient item Life-giving Chamber now deals piercing damage to you, instead of setting your HP, and will activate any relevant effects related to taking damage.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with the Bloodmage's Active Ability not counting all damage taken.
Fixed an issue with the rewards from the "Citizen Caning" event.
Fixed an issue where the healing percentage in the damage log would be incorrect in Act 2.
Fixed an issue with the Seven of Cups blessing not updating the description on potions you already have.

notes.title: Bug Fixes (Early Access v.2.0.1)
notes.notes:
Fixed a crash when upgrading an item in your backpack.
Fixed an issue where the combat result window could prevent progress after some events.
Fixed an issue with the Gladiator's passive ability reducing current hp.

notes.title: Some Changes, Bug Fixes (Early Access v.1.2.5)
notes.notes:
Event dialogue now has a fade effect.
Heroes in the tavern move around less, and performance on this screen has been improved.
The rare item Tundra Talisman now applies Frost faster.
The ancient item Life-giving Chamber now leaves you with more HP after activation.
The ancient item Odd Bean now recovers more HP.
The ancient item Neb's Crystal Weaver now applies a Shield at the start of combat.

notes.title: New Items, Bug Fixes (Early Access v.1.2.3)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Act 2 development is progressing very smoothly, I hope to have it live in less than a month. Here are some minor additions and fixes I have made along the way.

Two new items have been added; the rare item Mage Seeker, and the ancient item Esoteric Keystone.
The ancient item Plate of the Fallen now gives Divine for longer.
The ancient item War Mage's Greatstaff now generates Shield every 5 seconds, instead of just at the start of combat.
The ancient item Demon Prison now deals damage every 10 seconds instead of every 15.
The potion Bottled Blizzard now applies an additional stack of Frost.
Minor text changes on some items and abilities.
Start of combat effects now happen in a set order (hero abilities>enemy abilities>item effects>potion effects).
Fixed a bug causing some "start of combat" items to not stack.
Fixed a bug where item combat text would overlap.
Fixed a bug preventing your Active Ability being activated while Crown of the Banshee Queen was active.
Fixed a bug where the last stack of Negate could prevent multiple effects.

Thanks,
Dale.

notes.title: Minor Changes (Early Access v.1.2.2)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Some minor changes/fixes are now live.

When an ability is upgraded, a star will now appear below the hero.
The Ancient Defender elite now does slightly more damage.
Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't open if the "Goo For It" event was the last save.
Fixed a bug where the Ancient Defender elite would deal damage to knocked out heroes.
Fixed a bug with removing Negate when there are multiple stacks.
Fixed a bug causing the merchant music to continue playing outside of it's event.
Fixed a bug causing upgraded items to not be equipped to heroes when loading a save.

Thanks,
Dale.

notes.notes:
Hi all,

Some minor changes are now live.

The potions Bog Jar and Mana Bomb are now more potent.
Tooltips will no longer disappear when a hero or enemy attacks.
Fixed a bug making sound effects play much louder when multiple targets are hit.
Fixed the position of the helper arrow at the start of the game.

Thanks,
Dale.

notes.title: Game Balance, Visual Updates, Bug Fixes (Early Access v.1.0.3)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just a bunch of small wish list updates before the major new features hit.

Game Balance
Most heroes have had their base stats slightly adjusted.
The Paladin's burn damage is now more potent.
The Assassin's poison damage is now more potent.
The Berserker's Passive now increases more attack when upgraded.
The Berserker's Passive now works properly on each Active Ability strike.
The Warlock's Passive no longer increases Max HP, but the healing portion is more potent.
The Pyromancer's Active Ability isn't as strong when upgraded.
The ancient item Haldonir's Cursed Blade now heals you from Attack damage and Active Ability damage.

Visual Updates
The merchant now has a button to show the map attached to it's window.
All hero, enemy, and item tooltips will now show a number in brackets to represent the % value of something, eg. 250% Attack Damage (134).

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where tool tips would randomly disappear during battle.

notes.notes:

I pushed an update earlier today, as well as one more just now which will improve the experience on small screens greatly.

Early Access v.1.0.2
Fixed an issue where screens under 1920px in width would crash at startup.
Fixed many graphical bugs on low resolution monitors.


Thanks and apologies to anyone these issues affected,
Dale.
